events.subtitle: SOUL POWER
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents AKIKO WADA -SOUL POWER- on Friday, December 18 and Saturday, December 19, 2026. The December 18 performance opens at 17:30 and starts at 19:00; the December 19 performance opens at 16:30 and starts at 18:00, with one show per day. Blue Note Tokyo lists an ¥18,000 music charge. The announced eleven-person lineup is Akiko Wada on vocals with Eiji Yamaguchi on guitar, Takeshi Watanabe on piano, Yoshiyuki Kuriyama on bass, Ippei Anbo on keyboards, Yutaka Watanabe on drums, Yuya Yoneda and Michihiro Hanebuchi on saxophones, Naohito Watanabe on trumpet, and Yoko Anna and Atsuko Takezawa on backing vocals. Blue Note Tokyo describes this as Wada's recurring annual engagement at the club and says she takes on new songs in the series each year; no specific 2026 repertoire, anniversary, farewell or premiere is announced, so none is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Akiko Wada is not here as a generic legacy name. This is Japanese R&B history heard at close range: her voice in front of an eleven-person soul band with three horns, two backing singers and a full rhythm section, inside Blue Note Tokyo rather than a large hall. The club's annual series also gives her room to keep refreshing the repertoire instead of treating the catalog as a museum piece.
en.trip_verdict: If December 18 or 19 fits naturally into a Tokyo stay, this is a strong evening option in Aoyama and worth choosing over a routine night out. I would not move a rarer Tokyo engagement or build travel around this annual edition alone.
en.listen_before: Akiko Wada — WADA AKIKO ALL TIME BEST

es.why_it_matters: Akiko Wada no entra aquí sólo como un nombre histórico. Es una manera de escuchar de cerca una parte fundamental del R&B japonés: su voz frente a una banda de once músicos con tres metales, dos coristas y una sección rítmica completa, dentro de Blue Note Tokyo y no en un gran auditorio. Además, la serie anual del club le deja espacio para seguir renovando el repertorio en vez de convertir el catálogo en una pieza de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 18 o 19 de diciembre encaja naturalmente dentro de una estancia en Tokio, es una muy buena opción para construir la noche en Aoyama y escogerla sobre una salida rutinaria. No movería una fecha más rara en Tokio ni armaría un viaje alrededor de esta edición anual por sí sola.
